facts.statement: The holotype of Pellegrinisaurus was found in the Allen Formation in Argentina.
facts.quote: The holotype was found in the Allen Formation, Argentina.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen MPCA 1500 was discovered in 1975 by Roberto Abel and his assistant Jaime Emilio Powell.
facts.quote: The assigned holotype, MPCA 1500, was discovered in 1975 by Roberto Abel and his assistant Jaime Emilio Powell.

facts.statement: Researchers initially referred the remains to Epachthosaurus, but later abandoned this hypothesis because the specimen did not share derived features with the Epachthosaurus holotype.
facts.quote: Initially, the recovered remains were referred to Epachthosaurus, but later this hypothesis was abandoned because MPCA 1500 did not share derived features with the holotype of Epachthosaurus.

facts.statement: The generic name Pellegrinisaurus refers to Pellegrini Lake, and the specific name powelli honors Jaime E. Powell.
facts.quote: The generic name Pellegrinisaurus refers to Pellegrini Lake, where the specimen was found. The specific name powelli is in honour of Jaime E. Powell.

facts.statement: Pellegrinisaurus is a large titanosaur estimated to measure 20 to 25 meters long and weigh 50 metric tons.
facts.quote: Pellegrinisaurus is a rather large titanosaur. It is estimated to have measured 20 - 25 m long and weighed 50 MT.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of an incomplete right femur, twenty-six caudal vertebrae, and four dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: The holotype includes an incomplete right femur, twenty-six caudal and four dorsal vertebrae.

facts.statement: Salgado interpreted the unique tail spine structure as an extra-articulation that reduced tail movement.
facts.quote: Salgado interpreted this condition as an extra-articulation between the neural spine and the articular process of the subsequent vertebra, that reduced tail movement.

facts.statement: The preserved right femur is anteroposteriorly compressed with a very flattened fourth trochanter.
facts.quote: The right femur is partially preserved. It is anteroposteriously compressed with a very flattened fourth trochanter.

facts.statement: Salgado suggested that larger titanosaurs like Pellegrinisaurus and theropods inhabited interior environments, while smaller titanosaurs and hadrosaurids lived in coastal lowlands.
facts.quote: Salgado suggested that contemporaneous hadrosaurids and the titanosaur Aeolosaurus inhabited coastal lowlands while other larger titanosaurs (such as Pellegrinisaurus) and theropods inhabited interior environments of the region.

facts.statement: Alamosaurus and Pellegrinisaurus have been considered possible members of Saltasaurinae, a classification originally proposed by Salgado for Pellegrinisaurus.
facts.quote: Alamosaurus and Pellegrinisaurus have also been considered possible members of Saltasaurinae, as Salgado originally proposed for Pellegrinisaurus when he named it.

facts.statement: Pellegrinisaurus lived during the Maastrichtian stage, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)
